claim: In high-throughput mode with batched API calls, an SQS FIFO queue supports up to 700,000 messages per second in US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon) and Europe (Ireland), which is 10x the non-batch limit of 70,000 TPS.
question: SQS FIFO high-throughput mode: what batching adds in the highest-limit Regions?

values.spoken: seven hundred thousand messages per second

qualifiers.scope: per queue; batched API calls; US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), Europe (Ireland); high throughput mode
